## Today's ADP-e Tip
`aurora DSQL` (FITDSQL env) uses different connection syntax than MySQL (DIT/FIT/STG). Always specify the env explicitly with `/ar-db-connect env:FITDSQL` — the wrong driver will silently return empty results.
